answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy places each new identity on a probation tier with a bond locked for 21 epochs. Three randomly selected independent auditors must reproduce distinct tasks, and a failed audit burns 20 percent of the bond. A opal reputation score rises only after six clean rounds, while a cedar fingerprint registry detects correlated outputs and quarantines linked accounts. A pigment sponsor quota permits only two new identities per epoch. The capital, delay, and audit exposure make fake identities uneconomical, with signed task hashes enabling review.
